en: Wallace
Welcome, {player}. I am Wallace, the Champion of the Hoenn region.
Do you remember the day you won the Rain Badge from Juan? Something in the way you battled stayed with me.
I wondered then whether you would make it all the way here. And now here you stand.
Then let me show you what a Champion is. You and your Pokémon will see a battle like no other!
Wallace
I, the Champion, have been beaten... You and your Pokémon were simply magnificent.
You fought with everything you had, and your Pokémon fought for you. That is a true Champion's battle.
{rival}
{player}! I came as fast as I could. Listen, about the Champion, I've got some advice for you...
Wait... Is it already over? You beat the Champion? Oh, {player}, that's amazing!
{player}! I ran all the way here. Look, before you take on the Champion, you need to know...
Hang on. It's over already? You won? Seriously? ...Yeah. Of course you did.
Prof. Birch
Phew! There you are, {player}! I came to see how my Pokédex was getting along, and look what I've walked into.
You've filled it with so many Pokémon on your journey. It's done more for my research than I ever hoped.
And you've become the Champion as well! Congratulations, {player}! I couldn't be prouder.
Wallace
{player}, there is somewhere I must take you. Come with me, please.
I'm sorry, but only the new Champion may come through this door. Would the two of you wait out here?
{rival}
Of course! Go on, {player}. We'll be right here when you come back!
Wallace
You are the Champion now, {player}. Carry it well.
{rival}
We'll wait here, {player}. Go on!
Prof. Birch
Go on, {player}. We'll be right here.
